text:
I dreamed an escape. And I dreamed

of your lace scattered through the room.

Along a pier, some mother;

and her fifteen years nursing an hour.


I dreamed an escape. A “forever”

breathed upon the stairway of a prow;

I dreamed a mother;

fresh little shoots of green,

and a bridal chest constellated with dawn.


Along a pier…

And along a throat that drowns!

translation.title: I Dreamed an Escape. And I Dreamed…
translation.editorial_note: Hora remains an hour rather than a child, preserving the surreal compression of youth, maternity, and time.
